note: Test records only: not trades and not advice. Software tests passing does not prove a model works; only enough finished picks, judged against the same stocks' own average, can show that.
nifty_note: NIFTY 50 comparison = buying the index at the next session's open and holding to the same exit day, no costs. A yardstick, not something the bot trades.
edge_notes: 5-day edge = the picks' average minus every eligible stock's average, per signal day (the 5-day test's own measure).
10- and 15-day edge = each pick minus the average of every eligible stock of the same size group on the same day.
fold_model_note: The 15-day lab trains one model per test fold (246 in all). Those fold models only measure ranking skill in the history test; they never make daily picks. A daily lane uses one frozen final model.
